parties: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited vs. Joint Commissioner of State Tax, Appeals, Pune Division-2, Maharashtra
headline: Lumax Auto Technologies: GST Demand Reduced in State Tax Appeal
sum: Lumax Auto Technologies' first appeal before the Maharashtra State Tax Authority has been partly allowed, reducing the GST demand from ₹3.52 cr to ₹1.04 cr (including interest and penalty). The Order-in-Appeal dated 18 February 2026 was intimated to NSE under Listing Regulation 30.
implication: Partial success in tax appeal demonstrates risk mitigation on significant indirect tax exposure; the 70% reduction signals potential weakness in the original assessment and may support precedent for similar GST treatment in the automotive component sector.
detail: Lumax Auto Technologies Limited, a listed automotive components manufacturer, received an Order-in-Appeal dated 18 February 2026 from the Joint Commissioner of State Tax, Appeals, Pune Division-2 (Maharashtra). The first appeal against an initial GST demand has been partly allowed. The original demand, including interest and penalty, stood at ₹3,52,19,923; the appellate order has reduced this to ₹1,03,78,580-a reduction of approximately ₹2.48 crore. The company intimated this ruling to the National Stock Exchange under Regulation 30 of the Listing Regulations on 19 February 2026.
